query:
WITH w AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT id,player_id,date,game_id,toi_per_game,goals,shots FROM public.wgo_skater_stats
WHERE season_id=20262027 AND games_played=1 AND date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-01' AND DATE '2026-11-07'
), j AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT w.*,i.id AS individual_id,i.gp AS individual_gp,i.toi AS individual_toi,i.ixg,i.goals AS individual_goals,i.shots AS individual_shots,
o.id AS on_ice_id,o.gp AS on_ice_gp,o.toi AS on_ice_toi,o.xgf,o.xga
FROM w
LEFT JOIN public.nst_gamelog_as_counts i ON i.player_id=w.player_id AND i.date_scraped=w.date AND i.season=20262027
LEFT JOIN public.nst_gamelog_as_counts_oi o ON o.player_id=w.player_id AND o.date_scraped=w.date AND o.season=20262027
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'observed_at_utc',now(),
'joined_current_summary',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('wgo_rows',count(*),'individual_matched',count(individual_id),'on_ice_matched',count(on_ice_id),
'bad_individual_gp',count(*) FILTER (WHERE individual_gp IS DISTINCT FROM 1),
'bad_on_ice_gp',count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_ice_gp IS DISTINCT FROM 1),
'nonpositive_or_null_wgo_toi',count(*) FILTER (WHERE toi_per_game IS NULL OR toi_per_game<=0),
'individual_toi_differences',count(*) FILTER (WHERE individual_toi IS DISTINCT FROM toi_per_game),
'on_ice_toi_differences',count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_ice_toi IS DISTINCT FROM toi_per_game),
'null_ixg',count(*) FILTER (WHERE ixg IS NULL),
'null_xgf',count(*) FILTER (WHERE xgf IS NULL),
'null_xga',count(*) FILTER (WHERE xga IS NULL),
'goal_differences',count(*) FILTER (WHERE individual_goals IS DISTINCT FROM goals),
'shot_differences',count(*) FILTER (WHERE individual_shots IS DISTINCT FROM shots)) FROM j),
'exposure_differences',(SELECT jsonb_agg(t) FROM (SELECT id,player_id,game_id,date,toi_per_game,individual_id,individual_toi,on_ice_id,on_ice_toi FROM j WHERE individual_toi IS DISTINCT FROM toi_per_game OR on_ice_toi IS DISTINCT FROM toi_per_game ORDER BY date,player_id LIMIT 20)t),
'latest_nst_audit',(SELECT jsonb_agg(t) FROM (SELECT run_time,status,rows_affected,details->'timing' AS timing,details->'urlsQueued' AS urls_queued,details->'urlsProcessed' AS urls_processed,
details#>'{nstProgress,state}' AS progress_state,details#>'{nstProgress,sourceOutcomes}' AS source_outcomes,
details#>'{nstProgress,networkAttempts}' AS network_attempts,details#>'{nstProgress,plannedRequestCount}' AS planned_request_count,
ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(details->'nstProgress')) AS progress_keys
FROM public.cron_job_audit WHERE run_time >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-07T00:00:00Z' AND run_time < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-08T00:00:00Z' AND job_name='update-nst-gamelog' ORDER BY run_time DESC LIMIT 1)t)
) AS evidence;
notes: Read-only bounded metadata or current-season public sports data; not native-source or BLSH acceptance evidence.
